commands.name: skill:conversation-to-impl-plan
commands.description: Transform user conversation requirements into a self-contained, execution-ready implementation plan that is also a complete program task order for a new agent. Use when asked to draft implementation plans, execution plans, task orders, tickets, task briefs, structured requirement docs, or handoff packages from discussion notes. Treat "Impl Plan" as the core content and "Task Order" as its executability attribute. Enforce required sections (Context/Background/Goal/Execution Boundaries/Success Criteria/Handover Notes in the bilingual template), require a TODO-tool-driven three-pass authoring loop in chat as a standalone process section, require $impl-route-clarifier and $impl-route-guide-author to finalize route selection and implementation guidance, and output a complete handoff document.

commands.name: skill:impl-route-clarifier
commands.description: Select an implementation route before coding by comparing multiple viable technology and architecture options with evidence-backed tradeoffs. Use when functional requirements are already defined but stack choices, architecture direction, implementation route, or repository organization are still unclear or disputed. Include dependency lifecycle evaluation (release recency, repository activity, deprecation signals, and stable-complete exceptions). Do not use when one route has already been selected and the task is to produce an implementor-facing guide document; use impl-route-guide-author instead. 中文触发：当需求功能明确但技术路线未定，需要先产出技术选型与路线澄清报告时使用。

commands.name: skill:impl-route-guide-author
commands.description: Author a detailed implementor-facing guide document from a selected implementation route, including per-technology intro and instructions, coupling contracts, module boundaries, file placement scope, key configs, non-trivial code examples, pitfalls, and cheat sheets. Prefer conservative execution of guide-defined practices first; when implementation hits errors, ambiguity, or version mismatch, escalate to official documentation lookup and record links plus reproducible query methods. Use when route selection is already complete and coding needs strict guidance. Do not use for multi-route comparison or route selection; use impl-route-clarifier instead. 中文触发：当技术路线已确定，需要输出详尽实现指引文档（而不是直接写代码）时使用。
